semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized grinding and polishing technologies crucial for semiconductor packaging processes.
summary: Carbo Tzujan Industrial Co., LTD. focuses on semiconductor manufacturing processes, offering advanced grinding and polishing solutions for IC carriers. Their technologies are essential for enhancing the performance and reliability of semiconductor packaging, particularly for fine-pitch and high-density interconnections.
capabilities: Advanced grinding and polishing technologies for IC carriers
Heterogeneous surface grinding and polishing (HSP) for copper, epoxy, PEEK, and PPS
Solutions for ABF, BT, and MIS type IC carriers
